senses.gloss: m. (סְגַל) = h. אֶשְׁכֹּל, cluster of grapes.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 13:23">Targ. Y. II, Num. XIII, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 13:23">Ib.</cite>, sq. <he>נחל סגולא</he> Ar. (ed. … <he>לה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 1:24">Targ. Y. II, Deut. I, 24</cite> <he>נחלי סגולה</he>.—Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ top <he>ההוא ס׳ וכ׳</he> that (much spoken of) cluster in the vineyard.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>הדין תורא דאת סבר הוא ס׳</he> that ox which you think you see (at a distance), is a cluster.—Pl. <he>סְגוֹליָּיא</he>.
